checks.name: Rank a suitable tower per building
checks.sql:
WITH buildings(pair_id, building_id, tower_id) AS (VALUES ('high', 'library', 'tower-80m'), ('low', 'library', 'tower-2m')),
visibility AS (SELECT * FROM terrain.main.visibility((SELECT * FROM terrain.main.demo_input)))
SELECT b.building_id, b.tower_id, v.status
FROM visibility v JOIN buildings b USING(pair_id) WHERE v.visible
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.building_id ORDER BY v.min_clearance_m DESC, b.tower_id) = 1
ORDER BY b.building_id

checks.name: Build a viewshed as rows
checks.sql:
SELECT count(*), count(visible), count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('visible', 'blocked'))
FROM terrain.main.visibility((SELECT cell_id::VARCHAR pair_id, 500015.0 source_x, 4100055.0 source_y,
x target_x, y target_y, 80.0 source_height_m, 2.0 target_height_m FROM terrain.main.dem_cells('demo://ridge.tif')))

checks.name: Composed: viewshed per demo tower
checks.sql: SELECT split_part(v.pair_id, ':', 1) AS tower, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.visible) AS visible_cells, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v.visible) AS blocked_cells FROM terrain.main.visibility((SELECT t.pair_id || ':' || c.cell_id AS pair_id, t.source_x, t.source_y, c.x AS target_x, c.y AS target_y, t.source_height_m, 2.0 AS target_height_m FROM terrain.main.demo_input AS t CROSS JOIN terrain.main.dem_cells('demo://ridge.tif') AS c)) AS v GROUP BY tower ORDER BY tower

checks.name: Composed: obstruction snapped to its DEM cell
checks.sql: SELECT v.pair_id, round(v.min_clearance_m, 2) AS min_clearance_m, c.cell_id, c.x, c.y, c.elevation_m FROM terrain.main.visibility((SELECT * FROM terrain.main.demo_input)) AS v CROSS JOIN terrain.main.dem_cells('demo://ridge.tif') AS c WHERE v.status = 'blocked' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY v.pair_id ORDER BY (c.x - v.obstruction_x) ^ 2 + (c.y - v.obstruction_y) ^ 2, c.cell_id) = 1 ORDER BY v.pair_id

checks.name: Composed: tower height sweep
checks.sql: WITH candidates AS (SELECT 'low@' || h.height_m AS pair_id, h.height_m, d.source_x, d.source_y, d.target_x, d.target_y, h.height_m::DOUBLE AS source_height_m, d.target_height_m FROM terrain.main.demo_input AS d CROSS JOIN range(40, 75, 5) AS h(height_m) WHERE d.pair_id = 'low') SELECT c.height_m, v.status, round(v.min_clearance_m, 2) AS min_clearance_m FROM terrain.main.visibility((SELECT * FROM candidates)) AS v JOIN candidates AS c USING (pair_id) ORDER BY c.height_m
